title: Sol artifact manifest (RFC-SOL-0001, published v0.2)
description: Normative manifest schema. Encodes decision Q2 (minimum environment manifest, 2026-09-07): environment.environment_id and environment.package_manifest are required; environment.kernel and environment.kernel_version are required by validator rule V0-12 when the artifact contains code cells. imported_from/provenance_status encode decision Q6 (imported .ipynb classification).

artifact_id.description: Well-formed per V0-02; stable for the artifact lineage (RFC section 9.1).

package_manifest.description: Digest of the resolved package manifest (lockfile pin).

reproducibility_status.description: RFC section 27.4 vocabulary; derived from verification records only (V3-03).

imported_from.description: Decision Q6: set when the artifact was imported (e.g. 'ipynb').

provenance_status.description: Decision Q6: imported artifacts declare incomplete provenance.
